title: `SKChatCompletionAdapter` cannot be used with `AssistantAgent`
body:
The model client adapter cannot be used with `AssistantAgent` due to the required kernel parameter that must be passed to the create call.

Can we instead perhaps optionally bind the kernel at instantiation time and allow it to be overridden at time of calling create?

linked_prs.title: fix: update SK model adapter constructor
